pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free Plan: $0, includes two-step Zaps, 100 tasks/month. Professional Plan: $19.99/month (annual billing) or $29.99/month (monthly billing), includes 750 tasks per month… Team Plan: $69/month (annual billing) or $103.50/month (monthly billing) for 2,000 base tasks"

plans.name: Team
plans.quota: 2,000 tasks per month, up to 25 users

nl.tagline: Apps koppelen en werk automatiseren, met duizenden integraties
nl.description: Zapier verbindt duizenden apps met automatiseringen ('Zaps'): als er iets gebeurt in app A, voert Zapier acties uit in app B, eventueel met AI-stappen en agents. Zeer toegankelijk, maar de kosten stijgen met het aantal taken.
bestFor: Niet-technische teams die apps willen koppelen
notFor: Zeer grote volumes (kosten per taak lopen op)
limitations: Prijs schaalt met het aantal taken per maand

en.tagline: Connect apps and automate work, with thousands of integrations
en.description: Zapier connects thousands of apps with automations ('Zaps'): when something happens in app A, Zapier runs actions in app B, optionally with AI steps and agents. Very accessible, but costs grow with task volume.
notFor: Very high volumes (per-task costs add up)
limitations: Price scales with tasks per month
